data.fullPrompt: Remove Desk Chair completely. Remove Rolling Storage Cabinet completely. Remove Wall Letters completely. Remove Photo Garland completely. Keep soft powder blue walls exactly as-is. Keep beige loop carpet floor exactly as-is. Warm japandi interior. White oak, cream linen, terracotta clay, brushed brass. White lacquered platform storage bed with integrated drawer compartments anchors the room, paired with dark walnut floating nightstand at 24-inch height featuring aged brass pull and table lamp with white linen shade casting 2700K warm task light. Sand beige textured 5x7 area rug with low pile centers the sleeping zone in foreground, defining the space with minimal border detail. Dark walnut floating wall desk at 29-inch height spans right wall with matte black steel bracket supports, 48 inches wide. Left corner tall dark walnut floor lamp with linen drum shade completes background layering. Two charcoal linen euro shams and sand knit throw blanket draped at bed foot add textural warmth. White painted steel ceiling fan with four blades and integrated milk glass dome overhead casts soft diffused warm glow downward. West natural light at 5600K casting soft shadows across the room. Shot at eye level, 24mm equivalent, f/8, perfect exposure, professional architectural photography, photorealistic, Architectural Digest quality, no people, no text.
